Why everyone chasing AI content is missing the point

The bottleneck was never speed of publishing.

By Nova Brief 2 September 2026 3 min read

The promise of AI content tools is volume: more posts, more pages, more variants, faster. But for most brands, volume was never the constraint.

The constraint was having something worth saying, and the judgement to know which ideas were worth the effort. AI does not fix either of those. It just makes it cheaper to fill the gap with things nobody asked for.

If your content had a reason to exist before AI, these tools will help you make more of it. If it did not, they will help you make that problem bigger.

Use the time AI gives back on the part that was always hard: deciding what actually deserves to be published.
